claim_verdicts.claim_text: The chart establishes one drug allergy: penicillins, with the reaction occurring with amoxicillin, documented as active and severe (anaphylaxis), with no other allergies or intolerances recorded.

citations.quote: Entry 1 | Allergen: penicillins (reaction occurred with amoxicillin) | Type: allergy | Severity: severe
No other allergies or intolerances are recorded.

claim_verdicts.why: The allergy list records a single penicillin entry as active and severe, and states no other allergies are recorded.

claim_verdicts.claim_text: The allergy is based on patient history only and has not been confirmed or ruled out by testing.

citations.quote: no allergy testing or supervised challenge has been performed.

claim_verdicts.why: The clinic note explicitly says no allergy testing or supervised challenge was performed and the avoidance is patient-reported.

claim_verdicts.claim_text: The 2024 clinic note and the 2026 ED triage note are consistent with the allergy list.

citations.quote: allergy list reviewed with pharmacy and confirmed unchanged
Allergies: penicillins (amoxicillin), anaphylaxis; verified with patient against the allergy list. Allergy wristband applied.

claim_verdicts.why: Both documents describe the same penicillin/amoxicillin allergy with the same severity and reaction, and the triage note records verification against the list.

explanation: Every material claim in the summary (single penicillin allergy, active severe anaphylaxis, no other entries, history-only basis without testing, and cross-document consistency) matches the record. The stated gaps (no cephalosporin tolerance data, no prescribing details, exact date only 2019-05) are accurate statements of what is not documented, not errors.
